body_markdown:
## Overview

The Apple 35W Dual USB-C Port Power Adapter lets you charge two devices at the same time — perfect for your iPhone and AirPods, or iPad and Apple Watch. With 35W total power, it can fast-charge most iPhones and charge an iPad at standard speed.

## Key Features

- **Dual Ports:** Two USB-C ports for simultaneous charging.
- **Compact Design:** Surprisingly small for a dual-port charger.
- **Smart Distribution:** Automatically splits power between connected devices.
- **Original Apple:** Genuine quality with over-voltage and over-current protection.

## The Verdict

The Apple 35W Dual Adapter is the perfect travel companion — one adapter, two devices, less clutter.

Check out the Apple 35W Adapter in the shop today.
